intents.scenario: Verify that a LearningComponent can be created with an auto-generated ID when no ID is provided
intents.acceptanceCriteria: Component is assigned an auto-generated ID

intents.scenario: Verify that a LearningComponent can be created with an explicitly provided ID
intents.assertionCode:
var component = new LearningComponent(componentId: "COMP-12345", learningSpaceId: "LS-001", width: 1.5f, height: 1.0f, depth: 0.5f, x: 10.0f, y: 5.0f, z: 0.0f, orientation: "North");
Assert.That(component.ComponentId, Is.EqualTo("COMP-12345"));
intents.acceptanceCriteria: Component is assigned an auto-generated ID (alternative path - explicit ID provided)
